text:
Ravi: idea 1: tiny hands-on  PlayLab Mini: 30m tutorial + live lab. focus on dev velocity + a single benchmark slice (cost per 1k tokens). keep it low-friction and community-first. whos in?
Tess: in. i can do the short tutorial write-up and slide deck. recommend gated repo for pilot signups so we can track conversions.
Lina: i'll coordinate comms. want to A/B subject lines: A) "Ship a streaming demo in 30m (PlayLab Mini)" B) "Build with Redwood: 30-minute starter + benchmark". which resonates more?
Omar: I'd run both. also propose two CTAs on landing: "Try the lab" (quick flow) and "Request pilot" (forms). route pilot leads to enterprise list.
Ravi: good. Lina can you draft email copy + tweets? keep the benchmark angle subtle  highlight cost and latency headline stat.
Lina: draft copy snippet for email preview: "Build a streaming LLM demo in 30 minutes using our PlayLab Mini. See real benchmarks for latency & token cost. Join the live lab or grab the repo."
DevBot: notification: calendar created "PlayLab Mini dry run" 2025-07-19 09:00PT. link: https://calendar.example.com/event/54321
Tess: tracking plan: UTM campaign=playlab_mini_v1, utm_source=newsletter/tweet. HubSpot form with hidden field: source_channel. also add property "ConvertedToPilot" true/false.
Ravi: Omar  can you wire a small webhook to post to #sales when ConvertedToPilot=true? want SDRs to follow quickly.
Omar: yup. will stub lambda + HubSpot workflow.
Jules: is anyone doing the benchmark run? small script: run 200 requests at different seq lengths (64/256), record p50/p95 token latency and avg cost. I can produce a tiny chart.
Tess: assign owners: tutorial MD = Tess, slides = Tess, social assets = Lina, demo video = Jules, gating + HubSpot = Omar, email copy = Lina.
Lina: social card copy idea: "PlayLab Mini: 30m starter, measurable costs. Try live lab -> https://playlab.example.com. #devrel #LLM"
Ravi: let's keep messaging dev-first, avoid enterprise jargon on social. use benchmark callout in the blog and newsletter.
Omar: UX note: gated repo flow should allow immediate clone + demo token, but gate pilot assets (helm charts, full infra) behind form. reduces friction.
Jules: recording tonight and will upload 5-min trimmed clip to drive the blog hero.
Tess: timeline: day 0 draft assets, day 1 dry run, day 2 publish + send newsletter. tight but doable.
Lina: AB test plan: send to two newsletter cohorts (5k each), measure CTR -> gated signups. report back p1.
Ravi: final checklist: 1) HubSpot form + webhook (Omar) 2) tutorial + repo (Tess) 3) demo video + charts (Jules) 4) email + social copy (Lina) 5) sales alert + tag mapping (Omar) 6) dry run calendar (DevBot created). reconvene tomorrow AM. :rocket:
Omar: ping me if you need sample HubSpot payload or webhook code. i'll post snippet in repo: 
```
POST /hubspot-webhook \n{ "email": "{{email}}", "pilot": {{ConvertedToPilot}} }
```
Jules: uploaded demo clip to gdrive, link: https://drive.example.com/file/abcd. posting short link in repo readme.
Tess: posting draft tutorial in repo now: https://github.com/redwood/playlab-mini. add UTM snippet to README: `?utm_campaign=playlab_mini_v1`
Lina: will prep two subject lines and schedule AB test. dropping assets by EOD.
Ravi: thanks all. keep thread updated with any blockers. would love a one-line bench stat for the newsletter (example: "p50 token latency 120ms, cost $0.08 / 1k tokens").
Jules: will aim for that number after the run.
Lina: copying in #community later for wider seeding. :raised_hands:
